title: Bulk link creation API
description: New capability: shorten up to 100 URLs in one request for marketing campaign imports. Items are processed independently with per-item results.
acceptance_criteria: Each item is validated and created independently; one invalid item does not fail the batch
Response lists every item in request order with ok, link or error
Response includes created and failed counts
Every item counts against the caller's rate limit; items over the limit fail with 'rate limit exceeded'
Empty or oversized batches, and unknown fields, are rejected with 422
assumptions: Per-item Idempotency-Key is out of scope for v1 of the bulk API
Same validation and SSRF rules as the single-create endpoint
non_functional: A 100-item batch completes in under 1 second on SQLite
No change to existing endpoints or the database schema
